colophon: Thus ends the Garbha Rakshana Stotram.

lines.1: Come, come, O blessed Brahma, maker of beings, lord of creatures:
lines.2: accept this offering, and protect this pregnant woman and her child.
lines.3: O Ashvins, lords among the gods, accept this offering:
lines.4: by this worship, protect this pregnant woman and her child.
lines.5: O Rudras, who are said to be eleven, accept this offering,
lines.6: made to please you: protect the pregnant woman always.
lines.7: O Adityas, who are said to be twelve, accept this offering:
lines.8: for the growth of your splendor, protect the pregnant woman always.
lines.9: O Vinayaka, lord of the ganas, son of Shiva, mighty one,
lines.10: accept this offering, and protect this pregnant woman and her child.
lines.11: O Skanda, six-faced lord of the gods, who makes the love of children grow,
lines.12: accept this offering, and protect this pregnant woman and her child.
lines.13: Prabhasa, Prabhava, Shyama, Pratyusha, Maruta, Anala,
lines.14: Dhruva, and Dhuradhara: these are called the eight Vasus.
lines.15: Accept this offering, and protect the pregnant woman always.
lines.16: O goddess of the ancestors, best of the ancestors, mother of many children, mighty one,
lines.17: best of the wise, who dwells in the night, who is at rest, dear to Shaunaka:
lines.18: accept this offering, and protect this pregnant woman and her child.
lines.19: Protect, protect, O great god, who shows grace to his devotees;
lines.20: O Govinda who rides the bird, protect this pregnant woman and her child.
